Backyard Baseball '09.name: Backyard Baseball '09
Backyard Baseball '09.summary: Play hardball with David "Big Papi" Ortiz, A-Rod, Jeter, Ichiro, Griffey, Pujols, and other MLB superstars as kids. Choose your favorite MLB or Backyard team or create your own. And now, for the first time on Wii, Backyard Baseball 2009 features NEW Backyard Baseball All Star Game and tournament mode along with season & single game options, create-a-player, Homerun Derby mini-game, and unlockables. With outrageous game play and awesome power ups combined with authentic baseball action, Backyard Baseball 09 is the most fun you can have outside the ball park.

Big Deal, The.name: The Big Deal
Big Deal, The.summary: The Big Deal is a follow-up to the 2008 title Road to Vegas. It is a card game featuring 10 different play modes including Texas Hold 'Em, Black Jack, Spit, Baccarat, Whist, Higher or Lower, Casino War, Solitaire, Pairs, Five Card Draw. Adjustable difficulty levels and multiplayer with up to eight persons.

Chokkan! Asonde Rilakkuma.name: Chokkan Asonde Rilakkuma
Chokkan! Asonde Rilakkuma.summary: A Nintendo DS game with Rilakkuma.

Dear Girl - Stories - Hibiki - Hibiki To.name: Dear Girl: Stories Hibiki - Hibiki Tokkun Daisakusen!
Dear Girl - Stories - Hibiki - Hibiki To.summary: Dear Girl: Stories Hibiki - Hibiki Tokkun Daisakusen! is an visual novel game, developed by HuneX and published by ASCII Media Works, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Deep Labyrinth.name: Deep Labyrinth
Deep Labyrinth.summary:
One summer afternoon, Shawn goes for a drive with his parents and dog, Ace, but the family car suffers a flat tire in front of an abandoned mansion. Ace is upset by something inside the mansion and leaps out of the car to investigate. Shawn's parents follow Ace, but fail to return. As Shawn tentatively approaches the dilapidated structure, the entrance door swings open, and he's drawn into a magical vortex. Reunited with Ace, Shawn must travel into the heart of the Deep Labyrinth to rescue his parents.

There is also a second story of another man who gets sucked into a warphole while talking on his cellphone. He finds himself trapped in a labyrinth. As he journeys through, he is forced to reconcile the past, and realize what it is that traps him in the labyrinth.

Each scenario has multiple endings based on the actions and performance of the player, as well as helpful items sequential playthroughs, to aid unlocking all the secrets of the labyrinth.

Etrian Odyssey II - Heroes of Lagaard.name: Etrian Odyssey II: Heroes of Lagaard
Etrian Odyssey II - Heroes of Lagaard.summary: In the Grand Duchy of High Lagaard, it is said that the Duke is descended from inhabitants of a castle in the sky. When an unforeseen crisis befalls the nation, it is decreed that the first explorer to retrieve the Grail of Kings from that mythical floating palace will be rewarded with wealth and fame beyond imagining. Enter the central city of Lagaard and begin your journey to the clouds!

Imagine - Dream Weddings.name: Imagine: Wedding Designer
Imagine - Dream Weddings.summary: Imagine Wedding Designer is part of the Imagine franchise, which targets stereotypically female fascinations. This time? Weddings!!!!

Impara con Pokemon - Avventura Tra i Tas.name: Learn with Pokémon: Typing Adventure
Impara con Pokemon - Avventura Tra i Tas.summary: A Pokémon-themed typing game where players type words that appear on-screen to defeat Pokémon. It comes packaged with a wireless keyboard.

Need for Speed - Most Wanted.name: Need for Speed: Most Wanted
Need for Speed - Most Wanted.summary: DS version of Need for Speed: Most Wanted brings the thrill of high-speed racing and intense police chases to the Nintendo DS. Players can dive into an exhilarating underground world where they must outsmart law enforcement while competing against rival street racers. The game features a variety of customizable cars, allowing players to upgrade performance and style to stay ahead of the competition. With its challenging career mode, unique touch-screen controls, and dynamic environments, Need for Speed: Most Wanted DS delivers an adrenaline-fueled racing experience tailored for handheld gaming.

Quest Trio, The.name: The Quest Trio
Quest Trio, The.summary: The Quest Trio is a puzzle game compilation featuring three distinct matching experiences across African and Asian settings. Players follow Rupert Pack's search for a legendary jewel board while engaging in jewel-matching, mahjong tile arrangements, and solitaire card challenges. The collection includes Jewel Quest Expeditions, Jewel Quest Solitaire, and Mah Jong Quest: Expeditions, offering varied puzzle mechanics that combine exploration themes with traditional matching gameplay. Each game mode presents different objectives, from restoring world balance through tile matching to pursuing fortune through card-based adventures.
